title: jired show result
description: Everything the workspace knows about one issue, or, given several, about each of them under `issues`

file.description: The issue's file, relative to the workspace; null when the workspace has none for it. The one field --path emits beside the key

source.description: Where the values were read from: the working copy when it has a file for this issue, the last snapshot when it does not

frontmatter.description: As jired models it; see the frontmatter schema

raw.description: With --raw: the server's own payload, including fields jired does not model and the ones it has no value for

sections.description: With --section: the text of each section asked for, by its lower-case name (description, checklist, children, comments, worklogs, attachments), as the file has it under the heading

issues.description: Given several issues: one document per issue, each shaped like a single `show`, in the order asked; `key` and the rest are then absent from the top level

warnings.description: Things worth knowing that did not stop the command
